89630: A mysterious girl who appears in front of Cocona. She's always bright and active, thirsting for adventure, along with having nearly no fear. She is also proficient at riding a hoverboard, often surfing the skies.
89631: A second-year middle school student who lives with her grandmother. She's an honor student who serves as the class representative. Because of her cautious personality, she's unable to step foot into new opportunities.
120453: An elementary school student and Toto's younger twin sister. Yuyu is calm and collected, while also speaking with little to no emotion in her voice. Outside of Pure Illusion, Yuyu wears a cast on her left arm; however, while in Pure Illusion, she wields a power fist.
120454: Cocona's childhood friend and classmate. Cocona relies on her for her cool and strong-minded personality. She cares for Cocona deeply, getting jealous when she gets a new friend.
120455: A scientist who researches the, "Shards of Mimi," at FlipFlap, and created the TT-392 and other inventions. Hidaka is technical and excitable, especially when it comes to his work.
120456: An unreadable man who is collecting the "Shards of Mimi," along with being the leader of FlipFlap. Salt is cold and almost always serious. Despite that, he does care about what happens to FlipFlap's employees.
120457: An elementary school student and Yuyu's older twin brother. Toto, along with Yuyu, work under Asclepius to get amorphous fragments. Like his sister, he is calm and collected, even in dire situations. Furthermore, he speaks with little to no emotion.
120458: An operator that works for FlipFlap who, unlike Hidaka, is always worried about inventions.
120466: A robot seemingly created by Hidaka. It has various functions and is often used by Papika. TT-392 is often beaten up, be it by friend or foe, but is always fixed. Contained in its body is a brain, which gives TT-392 its traits.
120467: Cocona's pet. It can grow and shrink and show various facial expressions. It likes small spaces. Its name is a reference to the German biologist Jakob von Uexküll. While in Pure Illusion, it has a human-like appearance.
120468: A third-year at Cocona's school, and a member of the art club. Iroha paints many great art pieces, which Cocona sometimes is in awe of. She also believes that she doesn't deserve to wear nail polish, due to her past.
139541: The third amorphous child who replaces Yayaka. Unlike Toto and Yuyu, Nyunyu is lively and expresses many emotions. She gets along with TT-392, though she has wrecked it once.
139542: Cocona's grandmother who has looked after her for years. She is paraplegic, being unable to use her legs. She cares for Cocona, usually asking her if anything is wrong if Cocona is distressed.
139543: An invasive Pure Illusion Defense Mechanism from the desert world. Welwitschia is manipulative, reading into Cocona and saying how she feels deep down about Papika. She's also quite resilient and strong, causing her to be a difficult foe.
139544: An inhabitant and creator of the futuristic city in Pure Illusion. Pops is an eccentric inventor that has created many things, including the mechas that Cocona and Papika piloted. Pops is a small man, being shorter than Cocona and Papika.
139545: The girl Cocona sees in her dreams.
